title: Buffalo Bills' Josh Allen reveals how he spent his bye week
text:
Buffalo Bills' Josh Allen reveals how he spent his bye week Schedule NFL News Draft Fantasy Odds Betting Newsletter BILLS Bills' Josh Allen reveals how he spent his bye week
 Bills QB Josh Allen reveals what his plans were during the bye week
 Nick Wojton USA TODAY Oct. 29, 2026, 6:40 p.m. ET The Buffalo Bills are gearing up to face the Baltimore Ravens in Week 8.
 The Ravens (4-3) will be facing a fresh Bills (5-1). That's because Buffalo had their yearly bye weekend off from a game.
 Refreshed, quarterback Josh Allen was back at the microphone on Wednesday discussing the game ahead against the Ravens . But at some point, Allen revealed what he did over the time off he had on the weekend.
 Did he step away from football? Not at all. In fact, part of his plans might've been the same as yours: He was watching "Red Zone" on NFL Network.
